senses.gloss: pr. n. f.(b. h. שֶׂרַח)Serah, daughter of Asher, a legendary prophetess, a survivor of the Egyptian immigrants to the period of the exodus.
units: <cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 11:7">Deut. R. s. 11</cite> <he>פגעה בו סגולה</he> (read: <he>ס׳ בת אשר</he>).
